# Documented extension surface: the import paths an out-of-tree extension may rely on.
#
# Read by tests/unit/test_extension_import_surface.py. Every entry must resolve on this tree.
# Moving, renaming or deleting one is a seam change: bump CLOUD_SEAM_VERSION
# (app/auth/constants.py), set "seam_version" below to match, add a "moved" line, and record
# the move in docs/design/v<release>_downstream_changes.md.
#
# Formats:
#   module:name                     the attribute exists
#   module:name(p1, p2, ...)        ...and its parameters are exactly these, in order
#   moved OLD -> NEW @VERSION       OLD is gone; NEW resolves; the downstream doc that
#                                   VERSION points at names both. A trailing * on the name
#                                   is a prefix match (a group of constants).

seam_version 14
downstream_doc 14 docs/design/v070_downstream_changes.md

# Moved in seam v14 (0.7.0)
moved app.core.constants:CeleryQueues -> app.core.queues:CeleryQueues @14
moved app.services.task_detection_service:RECOVERED_AFTER_STUCK -> app.core.task_config:RECOVERED_AFTER_STUCK @14
moved app.auth.audit:query_audit_logs -> app.auth.audit_query:query_audit_logs @14
moved app.auth.dependencies:_get_client_info -> app.api.endpoints.auth.lifecycle_gates:_get_client_info @14
moved app.core.security:create_access_token -> app.auth.direct_auth:create_access_token @14
moved app.core.constants:DEFAULT_CHAT_* -> app.core.chat_defaults:DEFAULT_CHAT_* @14
moved app.services.search.indexing_service:_build_neural_ingest_pipeline -> app.services.search.pipelines:_build_neural_ingest_pipeline @14
